upal.can_fd.title: CAN FD frame transport (FDCAN-FD)
upal.can_fd.reason: Existing Phase 0 frame API validates arguments; exact controller/transceiver timing, message RAM, queues, interrupts and bus recovery remain unimplemented.

upal.uart_modes.title: UART framing and half-duplex direction modes
upal.uart_modes.reason: Needs typed framing, DE timing, turnaround, collision and DShot-UART semantics plus target mappings.

upal.timer_capture_events.title: Timer capture result/event publication
upal.timer_capture_events.reason: Needs edge/filter/wrap semantics, result delivery, overcapture policy and target implementation.

upal.synchronized_io.title: Synchronized ADC, timer, DMA and PWM groups
upal.synchronized_io.reason: Trigger routes and atomic start boundaries are target-specific and require capability resolution.

upal.usb_profiles.title: USB CDC and HID profiles
upal.usb_profiles.reason: The existing USB boundary is reserved; class descriptors, endpoint budgets and lifecycle are not defined.

umid.storage_transactions.title: Backend-neutral transactional storage
umid.storage_transactions.reason: The public record/backend contract and fail-closed service source exist; atomic commit, record verification, recovery, and backend qualification remain unimplemented.

umid.calibration_records.title: Driver-owned calibration record envelope and persistence
umid.calibration_records.reason: The identity/version-bound envelope has a fail-closed source; driver math remains user-owned and persistence is not implemented.

umid.blackbox.title: Binary blackbox acquisition logging
umid.blackbox.reason: Typed records, backend, caller-owned queue, and capacity fields have a fail-closed source; rate validation, buffering, backpressure, recovery and wear behavior remain unimplemented.

umid.plc_process_image.title: Typed PLC/external-peer process image
umid.plc_process_image.reason: The instance-aware scan contract has a fail-closed source and includes generation, quality/freshness, authority, and safe-value metadata; staging, validation, publication, and synchronization remain unimplemented.

uapp.secure_update.title: Authenticated and recoverable firmware update profiles
uapp.secure_update.reason: Portable orchestrator and templates are implemented. Deployment still requires authenticated canonical-manifest/crypto providers, durable staging and progress, exact compatibility, verified boot health and power-loss-qualified rollback.

uproto.modbus.title: Modbus RTU and TCP adapter
uproto.modbus.reason: Typed declarations and fail-closed C definitions exist; role/function subset, RTU timing, TCP transaction limits, and process-image mapping are not implemented.

uproto.canopen.title: CANopen CC (CiA 301) bounded object-dictionary adapter
uproto.canopen.reason: Typed declarations and fail-closed C definitions exist; CANopen profile, object-dictionary limits, NMT/heartbeat/PDO/SDO behavior and optional stack boundary remain unimplemented.

uproto.tls.title: TLS/DTLS provider facade
uproto.tls.reason: Opaque session and credential-handle dispatch exists; crypto provider, trust policy, entropy, key storage, and security review are required.

uproto.mqtt.title: MQTT 3.1.1 and 5.0 client adapter
uproto.mqtt.reason: Typed client dispatch exists; packet limits, ACK queues, reconnect/backpressure, TLS, and broker interoperability remain provider-owned.

uproto.http.title: Caller-buffered HTTP client adapter
uproto.http.reason: Typed request/response dispatch exists; HTTP version, bounded headers/body, redirect policy, TLS, and exact provider remain unqualified.

uapp.fault_history.title: Retained crash and fault history
uapp.fault_history.reason: Portable canonical codec, CRC and record lifecycle are implemented. Deployment still requires architecture capture and an atomic retained-storage provider qualified for its execution context.

project_language.type_interchange.title: Option/result, tagged variants, flags, fixed point and boundary codecs
project_language.type_interchange.reason: Requires one end-to-end compiler path across AST, validation, lowering, C layout and editor contracts.

system_language.external_evidence.title: External FPGA/PLC artifact identity and qualification evidence
system_language.external_evidence.reason: System composition needs typed external artifact and evidence links tied to exact node/link hashes and conditions.

deploy.signed_update.title: Signed artifact and target update orchestration
deploy.signed_update.reason: Artifact signing, boot verification, safe staging and release policy are distinct from build hashes and ordinary flashing.

evidence.qualification.title: Capability-linked build, test and hardware qualification evidence
evidence.qualification.reason: Build provenance and structured evidence are different claims and need separate schemas and aggregation rules.
